title: multiple-testing/0.1
description: Profile for p-values adjusted for multiple hypotheses: R p.adjust, Python statsmodels multipletests, pyfixest bonferroni/rwolf/wyoung, Stata rwolf, wyoung and qqvalue (survey 2026-10-25, spec/profiles/multiple-testing.md). Requires specification.multiple_testing with the method, the error rate it controls and the number of tests in the family (plus reps and seed for resampling-based methods); and parameters[*].p_value_adjusted on the tested rows. A family can span several models (outcomes): their tested rows sit in one record, told apart by response. The tools' defaults differ (p.adjust holm, multipletests holm-sidak), so the method is always recorded.

x-tools.p.adjust: method ("holm"; hochberg, hommel, bonferroni, BH, BY)
x-tools.multipletests: method ("hs" = holm_sidak; bonferroni, sidak, holm, simes-hochberg, hommel, fdr_bh, fdr_by, fdr_tsbh, fdr_tsbky)

family.description: What the family is, in words ("X2 across outcomes Y and Y2").

resampling.description: How the null distribution was resampled.

records.description: ids of the records of the underlying models, when they are written separately.

test_family.description: Family id when a record holds several families.
